The '''Aegis Mk IV''' was a model of three-legged [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] produced by [[Holowan Laboratories/Legends|Holowan Laboratories]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Produced at their [[Holowan Labs]] facility in the [[Network Security District]], the Aegis Mk IV was used to patrol the facility.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Holowan Labs Aegis Mk IV appears as enemies in the Imperial Heroic mission "Glitch" on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
